name: Complete Linear task from Todoist
description: When I complete a mirrored Todoist task, mark the linked Linear issue as done.

triggers.description: Runs when a Todoist task is completed

steps.title: Extract Linear reference
steps.description: Extracts the Linear issue identifier from the completed task description.

steps.title: Complete Linear issue
steps.description: Finds the Linear issue by its identifier and marks it as Done.
steps.prompt:
Find the Linear issue identified by `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef `` and mark it as done.

Use mcp.linear['list_issues'] with the query set to `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef `` and includeArchived false, to locate the exact issue matching that identifier. Confirm exactly one matching issue is found (match its identifier).

If exactly one issue is found, call mcp.linear['save_issue'] with:
- id: the exact issue identifier `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef ``
- state: "Done"

Return:
- issueIdentifier: the Linear identifier that was marked done (e.g. "LIN-123"), or an empty string if no unique match.
- matched: boolean indicating a unique issue was found and marked done.

steps.title: Summarize result
steps.description: Builds a short summary of the completed Linear issue.
